input.command:
DATE=2026-11-03
# local work-log
ls -la /Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/.cursor/work-log/${DATE}.md 2>&1
# provenance today
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
TZ=timezone(timedelta(hours=8))
day='2026-11-03'
paths=[
  os.path.expanduser('omdb/tgbot/data/task_provenance.jsonl'),
  os.path.expanduser('~/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/youchu_ai_inbox.jsonl'),
  'omdb/tgbot/incoming/worker_ant_agent_bus_inbox.jsonl',
]
for p in paths:
  ap=os.path.abspath(p) if not p.startswith('/') and not p.startswith('~') else os.path.expanduser(p)
  if not os.path.exists(ap):
    print(f'MISS {ap}'); continue
  print(f'=== {ap} ===')
  n=0
  with open(ap,'r',encoding='utf-8',errors='replace') as f:
    for line in f:
      line=line.strip()
      if not line: continue
      try: o=json.loads(line)
      except: continue
      # try various time fields
      ts=o.get('ts') or o.get('time') or o.get('created_at') or o.get('received_at') or ''
      s=str(ts)
      if day not in s and not s.startswith(day.replace('-','')):
        # epoch?
        try:
          t=float(ts)
          if t>1e12: t/=1000
          s=datetime.fromtimestamp(t,TZ).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
        except: pass
      if day not in str(s):
        continue
      src=o.get('source') or o.get('from') or o.get('kind') or ''
      text=(o.get('text') or o.get('summary') or o.get('prompt') or o.get('body') or '')[:180].replace('\n',' ')
      bus=o.get('bus_id') or o.get('id') or o.get('reply_to') or ''
      print(f'{s} | src={src} | bus={bus} | {text}')
      n+=1
      if n>=40: break
  print(f'count_shown={n}')
PY
# today's lessons
ls -lt ~/.dc-platform/memory/lessons/2026-11-03*.md 2>/dev/null
# local cursor work-log if any
cat /Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/.cursor/work-log/2026-11-03.md 2>/dev/null | head -200
